newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stock market closed on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: KL stock market closed on Thursday.

text.p: The Kuala Lumpur share market was closed on Thursday for observance of Prophet Muhammad's birthday.

On Wednesday, the Composite Index of 100 blue chips ended down 8.39 points or 0.83 percent to 1,004.09, just above the psychological level of 1,000. Concerns about a weak ringgit and high interest rates have kept investors wary.
"I think it (the market) is already at cheap levels, so it's time to actually buy," said an equity analyst with a local brokerage firm. "But it probably may not move up that fast."
